purpose: Join engine rules — how a stock's labels and today's weather stances combine into one total score per stock. WEIGHTS AND GATE SEMANTICS LIVE HERE so lessons/backtests can retune without touching src/join.py. Design guards: ONE VOTE PER FAMILY (correlated labels in the same family never stack), unknown scores 0 (missing data is never a vote), gates are flags/vetoes not silent score edits.

intrinsic_votes._note: stock-intrinsic labels that need no weather; smaller fixed weights so environment dominates

multi_tag_families._note: pipe-joined families vote as the MEAN of their member tags, still one family vote total

veto_when: earn:today — reports today, event risk not segment bet
ext:extreme AND weather risk=off — parabolic into hostile tape
flag_when: liq:low — thin dollar volume, hard to exit
short:extreme AND weather short:extreme=favorable — squeeze candidate, expect violence
